findings.endpoint: virological response in chronic hepatitis B (12 months post-treatment)
findings.finding_summary: This meta-analysis of five trials reported higher odds of virological response with thymosin at 12 months post-treatment versus placebo (odds ratio 2.67, 95% CI 1.25 to 5.68).

findings.population: e antigen-positive chronic hepatitis B patients
findings.finding_summary: This meta-analysis reported higher HBeAg seroconversion with lamivudine plus thymosin alpha-1 than with lamivudine alone (45.1% versus 15.2%).
findings.limitations: 8 trials totalling 583 patients; measures the combination against lamivudine alone, not thymosin alpha-1 by itself

findings.population: e antigen-positive chronic hepatitis B patients
findings.finding_summary: The same meta-analysis reported a higher virological response rate with the combination than with lamivudine alone (84.7% versus 74.9%).
findings.limitations: 8 trials totalling 583 patients; measures the combination against lamivudine alone, not thymosin alpha-1 by itself

findings.finding_summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 11 randomized controlled trials reported lower pooled 28-day mortality with thymosin α1 (odds ratio 0.73, 95% CI 0.59 to 0.90, p=0.003).
findings.limitations: 967 thymosin and 960 control patients; the authors report that high-quality and multi-center trial subgroups did not show a mortality benefit

findings.endpoint: time to recovery from common cold
findings.population: ENT clinic patients with common cold
findings.finding_summary: In this early clinic study of a propolis flavonoid preparation, reported recovery was faster than placebo, with placebo recovery averaging 4.80 days and treated symptoms lasting 2.5 times shorter.
findings.limitations: n=50; single ENT clinic, patients treated during 1987; non-English publication; randomization and blinding details not retrievable this session
